title: About us
heading: Aranya means forest. We bring a little of it to every space.
story:
The Aranya Club is a plant and garden studio in Visakhapatnam. We started with a love of growing things at home, from leafy indoor plants to fruit on our own terrace, and we want to make that joy easy for everyone.

We work online: you tell us about your space, we help you choose plants that will actually thrive there, and we stay on hand with simple, honest care advice.

values.title: Plants
values.text: Healthy plants chosen to suit your light, your space and our climate.

values.title: People
values.text: Clear, friendly advice, so anyone can grow a garden, whether it's their first plant or their fiftieth.

values.title: A greener tomorrow
values.text: Mindful choices: the right plant in the right place, and care habits that waste less water.
